posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina introduced son Vihaan to paparazzi at Mumbai airport, sweetly requesting no photos. Her Kay Beauty eyeliner is going viral across beauty circles.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's Imtiaz Ali film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' arrives June 12, while Sardaar Ji 3 drops June 27 — BTS shots already making waves.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alpha (YRF Spy Universe) preponed to July 3 release — Alia plays a fierce assassin in what's shaping up to be a blockbuster summer.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Citadel Season 2 is streaming on Prime Video, and PC is confirmed for both Krrish 4 and SS Rajamouli's SSMB29.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: 'King' shoot has commenced at Mehboob Studios — the title teaser crossed 90M+ views in 24 hours. SRK also shot a new Google Gemini ad.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Bebo's entered her padel era! She's wrapped Meghna Gulzar's 'Daayra' with Prithviraj and is reportedly in talks for Salman Khan's Raj & DK superhero film.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha signed a ₹17 crore deal for Ekta Kapoor's film, is in talks for Vicky Kaushal's 'Mahavatar', and is shooting Naagin.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is expecting her second child with Ranveer! She's using a body double for action scenes in Atlee's 'Raka' and is set to receive a Hollywood Walk of Fame star.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar premiered on TV May 30, with Dhurandhar 2 hitting JioHotstar June 4. Next up: 'Pralay' starts shooting August 2026.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya recreated her iconic saree look at Cannes 2026 with a bold sindoor statement, urging young actors to embrace authenticity.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Promoting Cocktail 2 (June 19 release) with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon — and addressing her viral shoulder moment with trademark humor.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha is promoting her Telugu film 'Maa Inti Bangaram' and turned heads at the trailer launch in a hand-painted Kalamkari saree.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Mega announcement: AA22 x Atlee officially confirmed — a ₹600 crore budget sci-fi actioner with Allu Arjun in a double role.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: 'Peddi' releases June 4! Ram Charan praised director Buchi Babu Sana as the trailer for the ₹350 crore film dropped to massive buzz.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: 'Dragon' glimpse shattered records with 64M+ YouTube views in 24 hours. War 2 with Hrithik gets a ₹100 crore offer for Telugu states alone.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Promoting 'Peddi' alongside Ram Charan, Janhvi says she won't attempt Malayalam again — meanwhile, 'Homebound' was selected as India's Oscar entry.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: 'Chand Mera Dil' crossed ₹26 crore worldwide in Week 1 since its May 22 release. Ananya's Bharatanatyam sequence is sparking debate online.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara discusses her transformative role as Nadia in Yash's 'Toxic' and opens up about her postpartum phase with Sidharth Malhotra.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: War 2 with Jr NTR gets a ₹100 crore Telugu states offer. Krrish 4 is in pre-production but Hrithik and YRF are navigating a VFX disagreement.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' releases June 5 — Varun's on a Mumbai promo blitz while navigating a legal row with Vashu Bhagnani.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya bought a luxury ₹29.7 crore Worli home! Her 'Unstoppable Tour' 2026 hits US and UK cities soon.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Rahman is reuniting with Shekhar Kapur for 'Masoom: The New Generation' as both composer AND co-producer. He also composed music for Ram Charan's 'Peddi'.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Historic political debut — TVK won 108 seats in Tamil Nadu elections, making Vijay a major political force. 'Jana Nayagan' (his final film) buzz is reignited.
